Bidesh and Beyond Volume IIIThe Almanac
Volume III · Pack Light

The Traveller's
Almanac

A curated checklist for the African plains
Essentials to Pack
01Passport & Yellow Fever vaccination certificate (mandatory for Kenya entry)
02Neutral-toned safari clothing — khaki, olive, beige. Avoid bright colours, dark blue and black.
03Light fleece & warm layer for early-morning game drives (mornings can drop to 10°C).
04Wide-brimmed sun hat & lightweight scarf or buff for dust protection.
05Thermal base layer (top) for layering under warm clothing on cold mornings.
06Woollen cap/beanie & gloves for early-morning game drives.
07Sunglasses with full UV protection.
08Comfortable walking shoes & closed-toe sneakers — broken in, dust-friendly.
09Toiletries — moisturiser, lip balm with SPF, sunscreen SPF 50+, body lotion, shampoo & conditioner, toothpaste, toothbrush.
10Insect repellent with DEET (malaria zone — mosquito protection).
11Basic medicines — anti-malarials (consult doctor), painkillers, band-aids, antacid, anti-diarrhoea, cough & cold, ORS sachets.
12Binoculars — essential for game viewing.
13Camera with zoom lens, spare batteries & memory cards.
14Power bank for back-up charging on long drives.
15Universal travel adapter — Kenya uses Type G (UK three-pin) sockets.
16Portable thermos flask & reusable water bottle.
17Slippers / flip-flops for hotel and lodge use.
18Travel documents — flight tickets, e-Visa, passport copy & the trip documents we will share with you digitally (please print before departure).
19Indian ID — at least one (Aadhaar / Voter ID).
20Passport photographs — 4.5 × 3.5 cm, white background, 70% face coverage (2 pcs).
21Swimwear for lodge pools.

Luggage
& Departure

Allowances, essentials and final words
Baggage Allowance

For International & Domestic Connection Flights

Please follow the cabin and checked-baggage allowances stated on your airline ticket, as limits vary by airline and fare type.

Departure Essentials
ArrivalReach the airport 3 hours before international departure.
LanguageEnglish & Swahili. "Karibu" means welcome; "Asante" means thank you.
Time ZoneKenya is GMT +3 — that's IST minus 2h 30m. 3 PM in India is 12.30 PM in Kenya.
PowerType G sockets, 240V — bring a universal adapter.
USD 50
Trip Tipping Pool · Please Note
A flat USD 50 per traveller will be collected toward a shared tipping pool for the entire trip, distributed across our drivers, safari guides, lodge staff and waiters — saving you the hassle of carrying small change throughout.
